name: Short stay and Schengen visa
summary: Monaco has no border checks with France. Some nationalities need a Schengen short stay visa (visa C) to visit. Check the official list linked on the residence and travel page.

other: Which nationalities need a visa was not listed on the page. Check the linked official list.

name: Temporary residence permit (carte de sejour temporaire)
summary: First permit for new residents aged 16 and over. Valid one year. Housing, income and other conditions were not on the page read.

other: Conditions such as housing and financial resources were not confirmed on the page. Check the application procedure on MonServicePublic.

name: Ordinary residence permit (carte de sejour ordinaire)
summary: For people who have lived in Monaco for three years. Valid three years.

other: Three years of residence in Monaco.

name: Privilege residence permit (carte de sejour privilegiee)
summary: Long-term card for people with ten years of genuine residence. Valid ten years. The wait can be cut to one year in special cases.

other: Ten years of genuine residence, can be reduced to one year in special cases.

name: Residence permit for spouse of a Monegasque national
summary: For spouses of Monegasque nationals who have lived in the Principality at least one year. Valid five years.

other: At least one year living in Monaco.

name: Naturalization by Sovereign Ordinance
summary: Granted at the Prince's discretion. Normally needs 10 years of ordinary residence after age 18, though the Prince can waive it. You must renounce your old nationality.

citizenship.note: Must be exempt from military service at home and renounce previous nationality. Children under 18 are included.

name: Nationality by declaration after marriage
summary: A spouse can claim nationality by declaration after 20 years of marriage (10 years if you married before 1 July 2022).

other: Still living together, unless widowed and not remarried.
Spouse did not get nationality through a previous marriage.
Taking Monegasque nationality must not cost you your original one under foreign law.

name: Nationality by descent
summary: A child of a Monegasque father is Monegasque. Through the mother, rules depend on how she held nationality. Being born in Monaco does not give nationality.

citizenship.note: Maternal descent has several conditions. Read the official page.
